claims.hypothesis: Is the supermaser burst symmetric in rise and fall and unsaturated?
claims.result: Rising and falling timescales of 2-7 months, symmetric; flux-linewidth anti-correlation
claims.finding: Consistent with unsaturated maser, saturation not ruled out

evidence.quote: The flux density and linewidth show an anti-correlation as expected for an unsaturated maser emission.

claims.hypothesis: Is the supermaser excited in the Compact Ridge by interaction with the low-velocity outflow?
claims.experiment: Proper motions relative to Source I and ALMA HCOOCH3 and continuum maps
claims.result: Features elongated perpendicular to the outflow; located at the edge of the HCOOCH3 condensation with a broad velocity range
claims.finding: Supports excitation in dense gas interacting with the outflow

evidence.quote: Our results support a scenario that the supermaser is excited in the dense gas interacting with the low-velocity outflow in the Compact Ridge.

claims.hypothesis: Does the supermaser need extraordinary conditions given 321 GHz non-detection?
claims.experiment: ALMA 321 GHz search compared with Neufeld & Melnick model

evidence.quote: It can be explained qualitatively by one of the theoretical H$_{2}$O excitation models without extraordinary conditions.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: 13-year periodicity considered unconvincing given weaker current burst and no 1973 burst

evidence.quote: would make the claimed periodicity of 13 years still unconvincing.

limitations_admitted.value: Model assumes a saturated maser and collisional pumping only, with superseded collision rates

evidence.quote: We note that the model employed here is calculated under the assumption of a saturated maser
